articles.title: A 219-acre Florida cattle ranch facing development pressure was approved for a $20.15 million conservation easement in September 2026, allowing agriculture to continue while permanently restricting development
articles.description: A 219-acre cattle ranch in Florida received protection through a $20.15 million conservation agreement. This easement is part of a broader initiative preserving over 4,500 acres of agricultural land. The agreement ensures that the ranch can remain operational while preventing future development. It reflects efforts to balance agricultural needs with urban expansion pressures in the state. Protecting this land is vital for maintaining both wildlife habitats and agricultural sustainability.

articles.title: London homeowner ordered to repay £225,000 to Thames Water over flood claim
articles.description: London resident Karen Imber faced legal action after claiming her flood-affected home was unsellable during mediation. Claiming damages from sewage flooding, she settled for £225,000. However, unbeknownst to the mediators, Imber had already sold the property for £780,000 prior. Thames Water uncovered the sale, leading to a court ruling that required her to return the settlement funds, highlighting issues of fraudulent misrepresentation.

articles.title: Stock market today: BSE Sensex tumbles 600 points, Nifty50 slips near 22,600
articles.full_text: Shares of Jio Platforms, the country’s largest-ever public offering, made their stock market debut, listing at Rs 1,359 on the BSE and NSE, a 21.36% premium over the IPO price of Rs 1,119 per share. The Rs 30,200-crore IPO attracted cumulative demand of more than Rs 7 lakh crore across the anchor and public book-building process. Investor appetite was evident from the outset, with the issue being fully subscribed within 100 minutes of opening. The Rs 5,500-crore portion reserved for qualified institutional buyers (QIBs) was subscribed within the first 10 minutes. Benchmark indices traded sharply lower on Wednesday as rising crude oil prices weighed on investor sentiment ahead of the US Federal Reserve’s policy decision. BSE Sensex fell 737.32 points, or 1%, to 72,861.35 while NSE Nifty50 slipped below 22,600 to trade at 22,586.40 or 182.80 points down. Dalal Street might be headed for a muted opening in pre-market assessment, with rising oil prices weighing on risk appetite ahead of the US Federal Reserve’s policy decision. GIFT Nifty futures stood at 22,593, pointing to a weaker start for the benchmark Nifty 50, which had closed at 22,749.75 in the preceding session. The expected opening direction came against a backdrop of elevated crude prices and attention on the Federal Reserve’s commentary on inflationary pressures and the future path of monetary policy. Jio Platforms’ anticipated stock market debut was another key event in focus.

articles.title: Jio Platforms Limited lists at 21% premium, m-cap hits Rs 12.5 lakh crore
articles.full_text: Akash Ambani, chairman of Reliance Jio Infocomm, said the response to the IPO had exceeded the company’s expectations. The offering received demand worth more than Rs 7.5 lakh crore and over 1.3 crore applications. “The response surpassed our imagination, breaking records in every investor category. We were fully subscribed for India's largest IPO within 95 minutes of launch, the fastest ever India has seen,” he said. Ambani described the listing as the beginning of a new phase for the company, rather than an endpoint, and underlined its responsibility towards shareholders. Jio Platforms made a strong stock market debut with shares were trading at Rs 1,357.45, up Rs 238.45, or 21.31%, from the issue price. The stock touched an early high of Rs 1,374 before trading at around Rs 1,357. At these levels, Jio Platforms’ market capitalisation stood at around Rs 12.5 lakh crore. Reliance Industries, which holds a 64.48% stake in Jio Platforms, was trading at Rs 1,197 per share around 9.59 am, up 0.07% from its previous close of Rs 1,196.20. Speaking at the listing ceremony, Akash Ambani, chairman of Reliance Jio Infocomm, said the IPO had received demand worth more than Rs 7.5 lakh crore, along with over 1.3 crore applications, exceeding expectations. Jio Platforms Limited (JPL) made a strong stock market debut on the NSE and BSE, with premium of Rs 250, or 22.34%, over its issue price of Rs 1,119. The stock was 1369.00, up 11 points or 0.81% on both benchmarks. Jai Shree Krishna…Let me begin with the one word that matters most today: gratitude. I am deeply grateful to the millions who believed in Jio and made this day possible. Thank you all from the bottom of my heart. Today, the bell at the stock exchange will ring for me like a temple bell. For me, business is a form of worship, and every worship ritual concludes with prasad. We offer this day at the feet of Lord Ganesha, Dwarkanath Ji, Shrinathji, Balaji, and the living goddess, Bharat Mata…Many years ago, a dream emerged from an ordinary home in Chorwad. It belonged to a young man who worked at a petrol pump in Aden, with neither money nor recognition. That young man was our revered Grandfather Dhirubhai Ambani. He showed us that an ordinary Indian can dream extraordinary dreams. Speaking at the listing ceremony of Jio Platforms Limited, Reliance Industries Executive Director Anant Ambani began by expressing gratitude to the millions who had believed in Jio and made the occasion possible. “Let me begin with the one word that matters the most today, gratitude, to the millions who believed in Jio and made this day possible. I express my heartfelt gratitude towards you all,” he said. Ambani added that the exchange bell held a special significance for him, likening its sound to a temple bell. “Today, the bell at the Exchange will ring for me as a temple bell because for me business is puja and every puja ends with prasad, and prasad is always shared,” he said. NSE is proud to welcome Jio Platforms Limited. Jio Platforms Limited becomes the 12th company from Reliance Industries to list on NSE. NSE and Jio represent two important pillars of India's growth story. Jio Platforms is looking to expand beyond telecom, with technology, artificial intelligence and cloud computing expected to drive its next phase of growth, the telecom giant's managing director Akash Ambani told PTI earlier. “There is no either-or at Jio: the network is our technology,” Ambani said, highlighting the company’s in-house 5G core, cloud-native radio access network and software platform, which serves 533.3 million customers. The company is also exploring satellite connectivity and next-generation 6G technology as areas for future development. Ambani said Jio’s growth opportunities span mobile services, home broadband and digital solutions for enterprises. He pointed to the scope for expansion, noting that around 26 crore Indians still use 2G services, while fixed broadband reaches only about 21% of households in the country. India has become the world’s busiest initial public offering market this year by the number of deals, with 246 listings so far. However, it ranks fourth by the amount of money raised, at $13.5 billion, behind the United States, mainland China and Hong Kong, according to LSEG data. Jio Platforms’ $3.2 billion offering is India’s largest IPO and attracted bids worth $77 billion. The listing is being closely watched as a test of investor appetite for large public offerings amid increased scrutiny of artificial intelligence-linked stocks. Several brokerages have described Jio Platforms’ $108.3 billion valuation as attractive, while flagging competition, heavy capital spending and changes in telecom rules as risks.

articles.title: School holiday tomorrow: Are schools closed on October 29 for Karwa Chauth in Delhi, Punjab, Rajasthan and UP?
articles.description: School holiday October 29: Schools in Delhi, Punjab, Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh may follow different holiday schedules on October 29, 2026, for Karwa Chauth. Government schools in Delhi are reported to be closed, while some institutions in Punjab and Rajasthan list the festival as a holiday or restricted holiday. The Rajasthan High Court and Central Government office calendars also include restricted-holiday provisions. No statewide closure has been confirmed for all schools in the other states. Parents should check official school notices.

articles.title: Tiger Shroff to resume 'Lag Jaa Gale' shoot in November with extra security
articles.description: Tiger Shroff is reportedly set to resume shooting for Lag Jaa Gale in early November, a little over a week after the October 18 firing incident at his residence. According to Mid-Day, the actor will film a 10-day patchwork schedule for director Raj Mehta’s action film, co-starring Lakshya and Janhvi Kapoor. The makers are reportedly keeping the shooting location confidential to prioritise his safety. Backed by Dharma Productions, the film is slated for a May 2027 release.
